title: Greeting Cards Apple Events Response Types
description: JSON Schema for all Apple Events command response shapes returned by Greeting Cards (com.kaymakcalan.app.greetingcards). Each response is a JSON string set on the reply descriptor's direct object.

SimpleResult.description: Generic success/failure result with optional error message. Returned by: reload, clear all, set card name, select candidate, set remove family, set model.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present only when success is false.

CountResult.description: Result that includes a count of affected items. Returned by: analyze cards, clear AI results.

count.description: Number of cards queued (analyze) or affected (clear AI).

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present only when success is false.

RenameResult.description: Result of a rename card operation. Returned by: rename card.

old_path.description: Absolute path of the file before rename. Empty string on failure.

new_path.description: Absolute path of the file after rename. Empty string on failure.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Empty string on success.

StatusResult.description: Current application status. Returned by: get status.

is_processing.description: True while OCR processing thread is running.

is_analyzing.description: True while AI batch analysis is running.

loaded_count.description: Number of unique card hashes currently loaded.

current_model.description: Model ID of the currently selected AI model.

year.description: Year string from the year control (e.g. '2024'). Empty string if not set.

LoadResult.description: Result of a load paths operation. Returned by: load paths.

success.description: True if the load operation was accepted (paths were enqueued).

count.description: Number of new PDF files enqueued for processing (excludes already-loaded files).

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present only when success is false.

CandidateInfo.description: A single name candidate for a card.

rank.description: 1-based rank position in the candidates list.

id.description: Internal database ID for the candidate.

name.description: Family name string for this candidate.

CardInfo.description: Full card state. Returned by: get card info. Also returned with only an 'error' key when the card is not found.

filename.description: Original filename (basename of the first file_path).

file_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash identifying the card.

file_paths.description: Absolute paths of all files with this content hash.

family_name.description: Currently resolved family name (may be empty string if unknown).

confidence.description: Confidence level for the current family_name.

method.description: How family_name was determined: 'ocr', 'ai', 'manual', 'error', or empty string.

manual_override.description: User-supplied manual name override. Empty string if not set.

remove_family.description: True if the family name should be stripped from the output filename.

ai_analyzed.description: True if AI analysis has been run on this card.

candidates.description: Ordered list of name candidates (best first).

error.description: Error message if processing failed. Empty string if no error.

CardSummary.description: Lightweight card summary for list responses. Returned by: get loaded cards.

ModelInfo.description: An available AI model entry. Returned (as array) by: get models.

model_id.description: Unique model identifier passed to set model.

description.description: Longer description of the model's characteristics.
